definition: meat from a cow
exampleSentence: I cook beef with onions.
exampleTranslation: Tôi xào thịt bò với hành.

definition: meat from a pig
exampleSentence: We had pork and rice for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Bữa trưa chúng tôi ăn cơm với thịt heo.

definition: the meat of a chicken, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Do you want chicken or fish?
exampleTranslation: Bạn muốn ăn thịt gà hay cá?

definition: the meat of a young sheep
exampleSentence: We had roast lamb on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chủ nhật chúng tôi ăn thịt cừu nướng.

definition: the meat of a duck, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Roast duck is my favourite dish.
exampleTranslation: Vịt quay là món tôi thích nhất.

definition: the meat of a turkey, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Many families eat turkey at Christmas.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều gia đình ăn thịt gà tây vào dịp Giáng sinh.

definition: salted or smoked meat from a pig, cut in thin slices
exampleSentence: I like bacon and eggs for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích ăn thịt xông khói và trứng vào bữa sáng.

definition: meat from a pig's leg, kept with salt or smoke
exampleSentence: I made a ham sandwich for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một cái bánh mì kẹp giăm bông cho bữa trưa.

definition: a tube of skin filled with minced meat and spices
exampleSentence: We cooked sausages on the grill.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi nướng xúc xích trên vỉ.

definition: a large thick piece of good quality meat, usually beef
exampleSentence: I'd like my steak well done, please.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn cho tôi bít tết chín kỹ.

definition: meat, especially beef, cut into very small pieces
exampleSentence: We use mince to make spaghetti sauce.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dùng thịt băm để làm sốt mì Ý.

definition: a small piece of meat on a bone, from a pig or sheep
exampleSentence: We had pork chops for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối chúng tôi ăn sườn cốt lết heo.

definition: pieces of meat with bones from an animal's chest
exampleSentence: We shared a plate of grilled ribs.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chia nhau một đĩa sườn nướng.

definition: the liver of an animal, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Liver has a lot of iron.
exampleTranslation: Gan có nhiều chất sắt.

definition: the flesh of animals and birds, eaten as food
exampleSentence: I gave up eating meat last year.
exampleTranslation: Năm ngoái tôi đã bỏ ăn thịt.

definition: meat from birds such as chickens and ducks
exampleSentence: Poultry must be cooked well.
exampleTranslation: Thịt gia cầm phải được nấu chín kỹ.

definition: the meat of a young cow
exampleSentence: Veal is more expensive than beef.
exampleTranslation: Thịt bê đắt hơn thịt bò.

definition: a small round ball of meat, often served with sauce
exampleSentence: We had spaghetti and meatballs.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn mì Ý với thịt viên.

definition: a large sausage with a strong taste, eaten cold
exampleSentence: I put salami on my sandwich.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho xúc xích Ý vào bánh mì kẹp của mình.

definition: a flat round piece of beef cooked and eaten in a bread bun
exampleSentence: We ordered two hamburgers and fries.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi hai cái hăm-bơ-gơ và khoai tây chiên.

definition: a cooked sausage in a long piece of bread
translation: bánh mì xúc xích, hot dog
exampleSentence: We ate hot dogs at the park.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn bánh mì xúc xích ở công viên.

definition: meat from the front part of a bird such as a chicken
exampleSentence: I eat chicken breast for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn ức gà vào bữa trưa.

definition: the meat on the wing of a chicken or duck, eaten as food
exampleSentence: We shared a plate of spicy chicken wings.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chia nhau một đĩa cánh gà cay.

definition: the lower part of a chicken's leg, cooked as food
exampleSentence: The children love chicken drumsticks.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ rất thích đùi tỏi gà.

definition: the top part of a bird's leg, used as food
exampleSentence: I prefer chicken thighs to breast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích đùi gà hơn ức gà.

definition: the leg of an animal, cooked and eaten as food
exampleSentence: We had roast leg of lamb.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn đùi cừu nướng.

definition: a piece of meat or fish without bones
translation: phi lê, miếng thịt không xương
exampleSentence: We ordered a salmon fillet.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi một miếng phi lê cá hồi.

definition: a sauce made from the juice of cooked meat
exampleSentence: Would you like gravy on your potatoes?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn rưới nước sốt thịt lên khoai tây không?

definition: easy to cut and eat, because it has been cooked well
exampleSentence: The steak was very tender.
exampleTranslation: Miếng bít tết rất mềm.

definition: lean meat has very little fat on it
exampleSentence: I buy lean beef to stay healthy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua thịt bò nạc để giữ sức khoẻ.

definition: the flesh of a fish, eaten as food
exampleSentence: We usually have fish on Fridays.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi thường ăn cá vào thứ Sáu.

definition: a large fish with pink flesh, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Grilled salmon is very healthy.
exampleTranslation: Cá hồi nướng rất tốt cho sức khoẻ.

definition: a large sea fish, often sold cooked in cans
exampleSentence: I made a tuna sandwich.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một cái bánh mì kẹp cá ngừ.

definition: the white flesh of a large sea fish, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Two cod fillets, please.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn cho tôi hai miếng phi lê cá tuyết.

definition: a common river fish, eaten as food
translation: cá hồi vân, cá hồi nước ngọt
exampleSentence: We caught a trout in the river.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi câu được một con cá hồi vân ở sông.

definition: a long thin silver sea fish that can be eaten
exampleSentence: Herring is popular in northern Europe.
exampleTranslation: Cá trích rất phổ biến ở Bắc Âu.

definition: a sea fish with oily flesh and a strong taste
exampleSentence: I bought smoked mackerel at the market.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mua cá thu hun khói ở chợ.

definition: a small young fish, often sold in cans
exampleSentence: I opened a can of sardines.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mở một hộp cá mòi.

definition: a very small fish that tastes strongly of salt
exampleSentence: I don't like anchovies on pizza.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không thích cá cơm trên bánh pizza.

definition: a long thin fish that looks like a snake
exampleSentence: Grilled eel is a famous dish in Japan.
exampleTranslation: Lươn nướng là món nổi tiếng ở Nhật Bản.

definition: fish and shellfish that you can eat
exampleSentence: This restaurant serves fresh seafood.
exampleTranslation: Nhà hàng này phục vụ hải sản tươi.

definition: a sea animal with a shell that can be eaten, such as a crab
translation: hải sản có vỏ, động vật có vỏ
exampleSentence: Some people are allergic to shellfish.
exampleTranslation: Một số người bị dị ứng với hải sản có vỏ.

definition: a small sea animal with a soft shell that you can eat
exampleSentence: We had fried shrimp for dinner.
exampleTranslation: Bữa tối chúng tôi ăn tôm chiên.

definition: a small pink shellfish that can be eaten
exampleSentence: I ordered a prawn salad.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gọi một đĩa salad tôm.

definition: a sea animal with a hard shell and two claws, or its meat
exampleSentence: We ate fresh crab at the beach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn cua tươi ở bãi biển.

definition: a sea animal with a shell and two large claws, eaten as food
exampleSentence: Lobster is very expensive here.
exampleTranslation: Tôm hùm ở đây rất đắt.

definition: a sea animal with a soft body and ten arms
exampleSentence: We ordered grilled squid.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi mực nướng.

definition: a sea animal with eight arms
exampleSentence: The octopus salad was delicious.
exampleTranslation: Món salad bạch tuộc rất ngon.

definition: a shellfish that can be eaten cooked or raw
exampleSentence: Have you ever eaten oysters?
exampleTranslation: Bạn đã bao giờ ăn hàu chưa?

definition: a small shellfish with a black shell that can be eaten
exampleSentence: We had mussels with garlic bread.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn vẹm với bánh mì bơ tỏi.

definition: a shellfish you can eat, with a shell in two parts
exampleSentence: Clam soup is popular here.
exampleTranslation: Canh nghêu rất phổ biến ở đây.

definition: a small sea animal with a flat round shell, eaten as food
exampleSentence: We ate grilled scallops with butter.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn sò điệp nướng bơ.

definition: an egg, especially from a chicken, used as food
exampleSentence: I eat an egg every morning.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi sáng tôi ăn một quả trứng.

definition: the clear white part of an egg

exampleTranslation: Đánh lòng trắng trứng cho đến khi bông cứng.

definition: the yellow part in the centre of an egg
exampleSentence: I don't eat the yolk.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không ăn lòng đỏ.

definition: an egg cooked in boiling water in its shell
exampleSentence: I have a boiled egg for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn một quả trứng luộc vào bữa sáng.

definition: an egg cooked in hot oil or fat in a pan
exampleSentence: I like a fried egg on my rice.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích ăn cơm với trứng ốp la.

definition: eggs mixed together and cooked in a pan
exampleSentence: We had scrambled eggs on toast.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi ăn trứng bác với bánh mì nướng.

definition: eggs mixed together and cooked in hot fat
exampleSentence: I made a cheese omelette.
exampleTranslation: Tôi làm một món trứng tráng phô mai.

definition: a white liquid from cows that people drink
exampleSentence: I drink a glass of milk every day.
exampleTranslation: Mỗi ngày tôi uống một ly sữa.

definition: milk that has had all the fat removed
exampleSentence: I drink skimmed milk to stay healthy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi uống sữa tách béo để giữ sức khoẻ.

definition: thick sweet milk sold in cans
exampleSentence: I put condensed milk in my coffee.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cho sữa đặc vào cà phê.

definition: cream that has been beaten until it is thick
translation: kem tươi đánh bông, kem tươi
exampleSentence: Would you like whipped cream on your cake?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn thêm kem tươi lên bánh không?

definition: a solid food made from milk
exampleSentence: Would you like some cheese?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có muốn ăn chút phô mai không?

definition: soft white cheese made from sour milk
translation: phô mai tươi, phô mai cottage
exampleSentence: I eat cottage cheese with fruit.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn phô mai tươi với trái cây.

definition: a soft yellow food made from milk, spread on bread
exampleSentence: Please pass me the butter.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đưa giúp tôi lọ bơ.

definition: a yellow food like butter made from vegetable or animal fats
exampleSentence: I use margarine instead of butter.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dùng bơ thực vật thay cho bơ.

definition: a thick, slightly sour food made from milk
exampleSentence: I have yogurt with fruit for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ăn sữa chua với trái cây vào bữa sáng.

definition: a frozen sweet food made from milk, cream and sugar
exampleSentence: Can I have an ice cream?
exampleTranslation: Cho tôi một cây kem được không?
